title: Lethe Shade
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Lethe Shade}}

'''Lethe Shade''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] which enables you to take 50% less [[Damage over Time]] if you've started taking Damage over Time in the past second, at the cost of having 100% more Duration of [[Ailments]] on you. 

==Mechanics==
Ailments that are reflected back onto the character such as through [[The Fulcrum]] or [[Maligaro's Restraint]] are unaffected by Lethe Shade's Ailment Duration modifier.<ref name="Reduced ailment duration and ailment reflection">{{cite web|author=Jatin_GGG|date=April 26, 2023|title="Reduced Poison Duration on you" jewel mod does not apply to poisons reflected using Golden Rule|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3366418#p24974604|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=May 6, 2023}}</ref>

==Location==
Lethe Shade lies on the upper right area of the tree, next to the [[Growth and Decay]] Notable passive skill.
